text: くさむらで　あたらしい　ポケモン　さがしてたけど　なかなかね…

structure.jp: あたらしい　ポケモン　さがしてたけど
structure.en: I was looking for new Pokémon, but

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ていた says something was going on; てた is the shortened spoken form. さがしてた = 'was searching'.

patterns.name: 〜けど
patterns.explanation: けど after a statement means 'but'. さがしてたけど = 'I was searching, but'.

patterns.name: なかなか〜ない
patterns.explanation: なかなか normally goes with a 'not' verb to mean 'not easily'; here the verb is left unsaid. なかなかね = 'it's not easy (to find any), you know'.
